data.situation: Patient of age not recorded presenting with triage level RED, chief complaint: chest pain radiating to arm with sweating. Patient stated: Doctor sahib, there is severe pain in the chest, it is going to the left arm, and I am sweating a lot. It has been for half an hour.
data.background: Reported symptoms include chest pain, sweating, arm jaw pain, and severe pain with a duration of about 30 minutes. Mentioned red flags include سینے میں بہت درد ہے، بائیں بازو تک جا رہا ہے، اور بہت پسینہ آ رہا ہے۔
data.assessment: Meets triage criteria for possible heart attack due to chest pain + sweating + arm jaw pain, age unknown, and meets criteria for severe pain due to severe pain reported.
data.recommendation: Transfer to Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology, which has the cath lab the patient needs.
